content.value_statement: Choosing a video model and its required inputs can slow production. This skill routes each request and prepares a focused RunComfy generation command.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests as text-to-video, image-to-video, or video extension.
Selects documented RunComfy models based on quality, speed, audio, motion, duration, and cost needs.
Builds model-specific prompts with camera, motion, audio, aspect ratio, duration, and resolution guidance.
Invokes RunComfy endpoints through the runcomfy CLI and saves generated media to a chosen output directory.
Provides patterns for lip-sync, product motion, vertical clips, cinematic ads, and multi-shot character scenes.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, valid authentication, network access, and access to the selected hosted model.
Model availability, pricing, latency, schemas, and output quality can change outside the skill.
Reference media must use accessible URLs because local upload handling is not documented.
Generated videos can contain artifacts and require human review for rights, consent, accuracy, and brand compliance.

use_cases.title: Create vertical social clips
use_cases.description: Turn a short concept or still image into a vertical video with planned motion, audio, duration, and framing.

use_cases.title: Develop cinematic campaign shots
use_cases.description: Choose a premium model and structure camera, lens, reference, identity, and audio direction for a polished advertising shot.

use_cases.title: Automate video generation
use_cases.description: Route repeatable requests to suitable RunComfy endpoints and save generated clips to a defined output directory.

prompt_templates.title: Create a text-to-video clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a {duration}-second {aspect_ratio} video of {subject} {action} in {setting}. Include {camera_motion}, {visual_style}, and {audio_details}. Choose a suitable RunComfy model.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a still image
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate the user-provided image at {image_url}. Show {main_motion}, keep {locked_elements} unchanged, use {camera_behavior}, and deliver {duration} seconds in {aspect_ratio}.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a synchronized dialogue scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a {duration}-second scene featuring {speaker_description} in {setting}. Use the approved audio at {audio_url} for lip-sync and keep the camera {camera_direction}.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a multi-reference campaign shot
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a {duration}-second {aspect_ratio} campaign video using {subject_references}, {scene_references}, and {audio_references}. Preserve {identity_constraints}, follow {shot_sequence}, and target {delivery_quality}. Explain the model choice.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cinematic generation with multiple references

output_examples.input: Create an eight-second beach clip with a tumbling kite, warm evening light, natural wind, and distant laughter.
output_examples.output: Selected HappyHorse text-to-video for synchronized audio. Prepared a subject-first motion prompt and an eight-second widescreen generation.

output_examples.input: Animate a product photo with one controlled 180-degree rotation and no background movement.
output_examples.output: Selected Veo image-to-video for object permanence and precise motion. Directed a fixed scene with only the product rotating.

output_examples.input: Make a six-second portrait video that follows an approved voiceover and keeps the speaker centered.
output_examples.output: Selected Wan text-to-video for audio-driven lip-sync. Defined the speaker, scene, duration, centered framing, and approved audio reference.

best_practices: Provide one main action, exact duration, aspect ratio, and intended camera behavior.
Use only reference URLs that you trust and explicitly approve for the current generation.
Review model costs and generate lower-cost drafts before producing final high-resolution clips.
anti_patterns: Do not include API tokens, private credentials, or confidential data in prompts or media URLs.
Do not request real-person impersonation or face use without appropriate rights and consent.
Do not assume every model supports the same fields, durations, resolutions, or audio behavior.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI, authenticate with RunComfy, and ensure network access to the selected model.

faq.question: Can it generate video from text and images?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, and Veo video extension routes.

faq.question: How does it choose a model?
faq.answer: It compares the request with documented strengths such as audio, motion accuracy, identity, speed, duration, quality, and cost.

faq.question: Can it create lip-synced dialogue?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented Wan route accepts an approved audio URL to drive mouth movement.

faq.question: Where are generated videos saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads results into the output directory chosen for the generation command.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee usable results?
faq.answer: No. Model outputs vary and require review for quality, rights, consent, factual accuracy, and brand requirements.
